summary: Plymouth dry-goods clerk, the eleventh of the twelve children of William R. McAvoy and Catherine Murphy, who married Frank J. McGuire in 1923; John's great-grandmother.
bio:
Elizabeth M. McAvoy was born on 8 December 1897 at Plymouth in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, the eleventh of the twelve children of William Richard McAvoy, who had been born in New York about 1857, and Catherine A. Murphy. Three of the twelve died young, and nine lived to grow up. Her father died at Plymouth on 4 November 1899, when she was not yet two, leaving her mother a widow with nine children from twenty years old down to the baby, Claire.

In June 1900 her mother, Katie McAvoy, was keeping a restaurant on Main Street in Plymouth's Fourth Ward, with the eldest daughter Mary working as a milliner and the five middle children at school. About 1903 Catherine married John H. Jones, a coal miner nearly twenty years younger than herself, and the family moved to 214 Vine Street. In April 1910 that house held the stepfather, Catherine and all nine McAvoy children, together with Mary's small son William Harris and Catherine's cousin Michael Murphy, a carpenter. Mary was a milliner on her own account, Agnes and Katherine were nurses, William a machinist at the automobile works, Josephine a telephone operator and Gertrude a squib maker at the squib factory, while Anna, Elizabeth and Claire were still at school.

By 1920 Elizabeth, twenty-three, was a clerk in a dry-goods store, still living on Vine Street with her mother, stepfather and nephew. On 20 June 1923, aged twenty-five, she married Frank J. McGuire at Plymouth, the Rev. P. J. Colligan officiating. The families were already linked: her sister Agnes had married Joseph S. Jones, a brother of Frank's mother Anna C. Jones, so the McGuire, Jones and McAvoy families were tied together twice before Frank and Elizabeth wed. She is John's great-grandmother, the mother of his grandmother Kathryn.

Her brothers and sisters were Mary (1879–1944), who married Alfred J. Harris; Agnes (1884–1958), who married Joseph S. Jones; Katherine Frances (1888–1933), who married Victor Roy Wagner and died at Jamestown, New York; William Richard Jr. (1889–1942), the machinist and later a travelling salesman; Josephine Regina (1891–1943), who married Joseph R. Hughes and died at Woodbury, New Jersey; Gertrude Calista (1893–1971), who married William Henry Ackerman and raised seven children at Camden; Anna K. (1895–1964), who married Fred Delbert Snyder and died at Syracuse; and Claire (1899–1975), who married Harry Greener in Philadelphia.

Frank died in Wilkes-Barre in 1958. Elizabeth later lived near her daughter Betsy at Altoona, where she died on 5 May 1984, and she was buried in Hanover Township, Luzerne County.

Round 4: 1914 docket re-confirms NY-born father; found that Harold Arnold (b. 1927) was her son-in-law, not her second husband.
About text rewritten as narrative; the earlier research-note text is kept under Evidence notes.

John asked whether she was one of six children. The 1900 census (Katie McAvoy, widow, restaurant, Main Street: 12 children born, 9 living, all nine named) and the 1910 census (Catherine Jones, 12 born, 9 living, all nine McAvoy step-children at 214 Vine St) show twelve born and nine surviving, not six. Census images read from the family's FamilySearch attachments and attached here. Also removed the old error that she married Harold Arnold: he was her son-in-law (Betsy's husband).

researchNotes:
Elizabeth M. McAvoy was born 8 Dec 1897 in Plymouth (FS KGQH-JNV), one of ten children of William Richard McAvoy (b. c.1857 New York, d. 4 Nov 1899 Plymouth) and Catherine A. Murphy. Her father died when she was about two; her widowed mother married John H. Jones, and in 1920 Elizabeth lived 'in household of John H Jones'. On 19 Jun 1923 (licence No. 635) she was a clerk, of 214 Vine St, Plymouth, aged 25, born Penna., father William R. (deceased, born N.Y.), mother Kathryn Murphy (Plymouth, born Penna.); she married Frank J. McGuire on 20 Jun 1923 (Rev. P. J. Colligan, Plymouth). Her sister Agnes M. McAvoy married Joseph S. Jones, a brother of Frank's mother Anna C. Jones — so the McGuire, Jones and McAvoy families were tied together twice before Frank and Elizabeth married. After Frank's death in 1958 she married (2) Harold Arnold. She died 5 May 1984 in Altoona and was buried in Hanover Township (FS).

Her sister Agnes M. McAvoy's 1914 marriage docket again gives their father William as born in New York and dead, and their mother Catharine (Murphy) as living in Plymouth ([R4-S1]). FamilySearch shows Elizabeth's siblings Mary (1879-1944), Agnes (1884-1958), William Richard Jr. (1886-1942), Katherine Frances (1888-1933), Josephine Regina (1891-1943), Gertrude Calista (1893-1971), Anna K. (1895-1964) and Claire (1899-1975) ([R4-S2]). A "Lizzie McAvoy" entry in the FamilySearch index "Pennsylvania Births and Christenings" is attached to her profile (probably her Plymouth baptism), but the record page could not be opened.
